title: A constant (n+1)-covector is the exterior derivative of its affine contraction (n+1)⁻¹·ι_{y−x₀}α
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let α be an (n+1)-covector on ℝ^P (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n+1), a continuous alternating (n+1)-linear form) and let x₀ ∈ ℝ^P. Let ψ be the n-form ψ(y) := ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ · α.curryLeft(y − x₀), i.e. ψ(y)(v₁, …, v_n) = (n + 1)⁻¹ · α(y − x₀, v₁, …, v_n). Then for every x ∈ ℝ^P the exterior derivative of ψ at x equals α: extDeriv ψ x = α. Here extDeriv ψ x = alternatizeUncurryFin(fderiv ℝ ψ x) is Mathlib's exterior derivative, which is SimonGMT's exteriorDerivative.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1)) (x₀ x : Euclid P), extDeriv (fun y : Euclid P => ((n : ℝ) + 1)⁻¹ • α.curryLeft (y - x₀)) x = α
